headline: Roosevelt unbeaten and scoring like no one else
dek: Roosevelt have scored thirteen goals and conceded six without losing, more than Davenport, Purdue Northwest and Wisconsin-Parkside have managed between them. Purdue Northwest and Saginaw Valley State are the only other sides unbeaten, and Saginaw Valley State kept that by beating Northern Michigan in the season's first meeting between members.
displaced_by: Saginaw Valley State beat Northern Michigan in the first meeting between members, so the dek's line that no member had met another no longer holds; the headline stands

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Saginaw Valley State have spread ten goals across seven different scorers and conceded five. The chart ranks what sides score; the sides scoring most are also the ones that have not lost.

wire.line: Saginaw Valley State beat Northern Michigan in the season's first meeting between members and remain unbeaten.

findings.label: observed

last_match.line: Saginaw Valley State stay unbeaten in the season's first meeting between members; Northern Michigan have alternated wins and defeats.

next_match.line: St. Cloud State's only win came at Truman; they have lost at Quincy and Saint Thomas since.
